concept.title: Therapies and relaxation sessions
concept.shortdesc: Receiving or taking part in therapeutic and relaxation services such as counselling, physiotherapy, complementary therapies, yoga and mindfulness.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : Taking part in or learning mindfulness, meditation and related relaxation or self-compassion courses and groups.
: Taking part in yoga classes and sessions of any style, including gentle yoga and yoga therapy.
: Receiving physiotherapy, occupational therapy and structured rehabilitation to recover or maintain physical function.
: Receiving one-to-one counselling, psychotherapy or other talking therapies from a trained professional.
: Receiving or learning complementary and holistic treatments such as Reiki, acupuncture, massage, reflexology and crystal healing.
